name: task-reminder
description: The agent is reminded of every shell it left in the background, with the tail and age of its output, until the task ends or the agent stops it

marks.title: Reminders at, minutes of run time
marks.description: When the reminders come, in minutes since the command started, e.g. "2 5 10 30 60 120"; the first one that is already past goes into the tool result that moved the shell to the background

every.title: Then every, minutes
every.description: How often the reminders go on after the last mark
